text: Artificial Intelligence, or AI, is the ability of machines to do tasks that usually require human intelligence. This includes learning, solving problems, and making decisions. Machine learning is a part of AI that lets computers learn from data without being programmed for every situation. Deep learning is a more advanced form of machine learning. It uses large neural networks to handle complex tasks like recognising faces or understanding speech. Today, AI is used in many everyday things, such as search engines, voice assistants, and recommendation systems on streaming platforms. It is changing how we live and work.
